regions.name: wall-tile
regions._note: Row 1 col 4: cracked-plaster wall texture, cool spy-HQ register. Region coordinates reused verbatim from t-59's committed manifest-tiles.json (wall-cracked).
regions._detail_note: CRACK-RETENTION FIX (t-141 round 3, moneta's GAP 2): without detail preservation this region rectified to ONE flat opaque color (88,117,124) -- the source's defining feature, a spidery dark crack network, was erased. Root cause: the cracks are 1-2px thin dark lines on a near-uniform teal field (region std ~4/channel); at pitch 10.08 every 10x10 cell is >=80% plaster, so whole-cell mode voting outvotes the crack in every cell, and the collapsed palette (len 1) is just the downstream symptom. detail_dark_min_frac=0.12 makes a cell whose pixels darker than its own mode by >=18 lum cover >=12% of the cell re-vote among only those dark pixels, so a crack that crosses a cell claims it: 16 cells now trace the primary crack fork/diagonals (palette len 5), matching the source at matched zoom, while the flat field is untouched. Floor group is a separate palette and does NOT opt in (its plank seams already survive) -- floor-tile stays byte-identical. Measured: no spurious dark cells fire on the flat field; every one traces a real source crack (see t-141 log).

_comment: Every parameter reused verbatim from t-59's committed manifest-tiles.json (commit 3071ab5), except accent_max_area_frac forced to 0 per the t-59 round-25 fix and anchor_region's height corrected (t-141, see below). Floor and wall are two separate groups/palettes per THE PALETTE LAW even though they share one sheet. Sheet path is relative to projects/bureau/references/office/ in the brain. ANCHOR FIX (t-141): the inherited anchor_region height was 240, which cut this sheet's own scale-anchor figure off at row 250 -- the figure actually runs rows 20..503 (484px tall) and the box truncated it to 230px, halving the derived pitch and shipping every tile at ~2.1x oversize (floor-tile 55x46 instead of 26x22, breaking the mission's 'scale consistent with the 48px anchor across the whole set' floor). The figure is a single cleanly-isolated connected component with no bridging into any tile (verified: measure_anchor_height returns a stable 484 for every box from [50,10,165,510] out to [45,5,175,540]), so the honest fix is to enlarge the box to contain the whole figure and let auto-measure derive the true pitch (10.0833), NOT a hand-typed anchor_source_px_height override (that override exists only for the different failure mode where components bridge across a divider -- not the case here).
